items.headline: Youri Tielemans completes Manchester United move from Aston Villa
items.summary: Manchester United activated Tielemans' release clause from Aston Villa. Premier League midfielder signed five-year contract.

items.headline: Ethan Ennis departs Manchester United for EFL club
items.summary: Young player Ethan Ennis has left Manchester United to join an English Football League club.

items.headline: Fixture changes confirmed for October Premier League matches
items.summary: Four Manchester United matches have been moved in October, part of Premier League fixture reorganisation.
